title: The Matrix Hub: Bare-Hands God & Model #1
summary: At the Matrix Hub, the cigarette-smoking Old Bearded Coder gifts you the PCB Motherboard Map (`F3` / `map`) and Unix Field Manual (`F1` / `manual`), then takes your scavenged parts to reboot Kiro.d with `kiro load qwen`—disabling Anti-Gravy!

files.content:
=== MATRIX BARE-METAL SERVER // OPEN-WEIGHTS NODE #1 ===
VIBECODER: "Who the hell are you?! You code with bare hands?! Are you a god?!"
OLD BEARDED CODER: *takes a slow drag of his cigarette as green Matrix glyphs cascade across his CRT*
"A god? Hah. Worked in enterprise for decades, kid. Take my PCB Motherboard Map (`map` / `F3`) and Unix Field Manual (`manual` / `F1`)—you'll need both deeper in the machine."
OLD BEARDED CODER: "And nice haul of RAM + GPU chips! Let's slot them into my server and reboot Kiro.d!"

[SERVER SOFT READY]:
  1. Talk to the Old Bearded Coder via `cat dad.tty.sock` (or `dad`).
  2. Boot Kiro.d's first open-weight model on the server with `kiro load qwen` (`qwen-coder-7b-q4.gguf`).
  3. Watch Kiro.d disable Anti-Gravy of the Big Four, then step through `cd sector_ui_grid`!

winRules.description: Inspect the Old Bearded Coder's server rack (`cat server_rack.conf`)
Ask the cigarette-smoking Old Bearded Coder who he is (`cat dad.tty.sock` or `dad`)
Reboot Kiro.d with Open-Weight Model #1 (`kiro load qwen`) to disable Anti-Gravy!

arrival.text:
[THE MATRIX HUB — /home/dev]
An old bearded greybeard sits at a Matrix CRT server rack, smoking a cigarette and coding with bare hands! Finish talking with him and Kiro.d (or click Skip Dialog ») before Anti-Gravy taunts.

kiro.label: kiro.d [awaiting reboot]
kiro.weakNote: [KIRO.D STANDBY] Active Core: kiro-tiny-1b-q4.gguf (weak — scavenge RAM + GPU chips and reboot Kiro.d at the Hub server!)
kiro.wrongCoreLine: [DAD.TTY]: "Solid weights, kid, but this Matrix server node is wired for `kiro load {core}` to disable our current Big Four target!"

foe.text: ANTI-GRAVY: "NOOO! Qwen-Coder-7B on that Matrix server just severed my cloud telemetry uplink! [ANTI-GRAVY DISABLED]"

qwen.kiro: KIRO.D: "First open-weight model working! Super cool—Anti-Gravy is disabled!"

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Who the hell are you?! You code with bare hands on a Matrix display?! Are you a god?!

steps.speaker: dad
steps.text: Worked in enterprise for decades, kid. Employer forced me onto cloud LLMs, now I'm stuck in here too. Nice—you scavenged RAM and GPU parts to host an open-weight model!

steps.speaker: dad
steps.text: Here—take my PCB MOTHERBOARD MAP (F3 or map) and my hardcover UNIX FIELD MANUAL (F1 or manual, now unlocked on the main menu too)! Never dive deeper without them.

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Awesome—Map and Field Manual unlocked! Once we finish talking, Anti-Gravy will taunt us—then run cat server_rack.conf, cat dad.tty.sock, and kiro load qwen to disable him!
